question: What does a status text value of "Old" mean during the maintenance of authorizations for an existing role? A. The field delivered with content was changed but the old value was retained. B. Field values were unchanged and no new authorization was added. C. Field values were changed as a result of the merge process. D. Field values have not been changed.
discussion: Selected Answer: D Status old specify that old values which are not changes still mainted as standard upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

Selected Answer: B A status of "Old" specifically indicates that no modifications were made to the existing authorizations during the maintenance process. This means that neither the existing field values were altered, nor were any new authorizations appended to the role. The context is the maintenance of authorizations for an existing role. "Old" signifies that the role's authorization configuration remains identical to its previous state. The "Old" status acts as a flag to highlight the lack of changes, which is crucial for auditing and tracking modifications to role-based access control. question: Which limitations apply to restricted users in SAP HANA Cloud? (Choose three.) A. They can only create objects in their own database schema. B. They only have full SQL access via the SQL console. C. They cannot connect via ODBC or JDBC. D. They can only connect to the database using HTTP/HTTPS. E. They cannot create objects in the database.
discussion: Selected Answer: CDE Key Limitations • No Object Creation: Cannot create database objects or schema tables. • No Default Data Access: Lack the standard PUBLIC role, meaning they cannot view system views or data until explicitly granted. • Protocol Restrictions: Restricted initially from standard direct database console paths like ODBC/JDBC unless specifically configured otherwise. • Restricted users are designed to prevent direct SQL console access upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
